title: Dungeon Odyssey
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Dungeon Odyssey: The descendants of mankind, born in the labyrinth and raised on the milk of monsters, possessed special strength and strong bodies. When they returned to earth, mankind referred to them as dungeon babies. Among them, Kim Jinwoo was born in the deepest labyrinth. “I never tried to become strong, I just wanted to live.” From the lowliest excavator to the king of the labyrinth, his life story is now unfolding.

title: Dungeon Reset
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Dungeon Reset: [Dungeon reboot in progress.] The dungeon or traps in which the game was going through are undergoing a reboot stage for the following users. Maybe this “reboot” applies to me as well ?! The only creature that is free of the constantly restarted Cave. Armed with tremendous power, the protagonist begins the development of the Underground!

title: GOBLIN SLAYER
summary: A brief description of the manga GOBLIN SLAYER: The young priestess goes with her team to adventure, but the road of adventure immediately leads them to trouble. Everything seems to be lost, but adventurers are saved by the Goblin Killer. That’s the name of the mysterious swordsman, whose purpose in life is to kill all goblins. The Priestess decides to join the boy, and goes with him on a new, more dangerous adventure. They have to kill goblins of all sorts of breeds in different ways, become on the threshold of life and death, meet friends, enemies, and even competitors.

title: I Obtained a Mythic Item
summary: A brief description of the manga I Obtained a Mythic Item: Yggdrasil, the World Tree of Norse Mythology, suddenly appeared on Earth. And with it came demonic creatures that ravaged entire cities. Although not all hope is lost, due to the System that a few special humans had gained. In this new world where only the strong survived, Min JaeHyun scrapes by regretting the wrong choices he’d made in the past… when one day, he gains the only Mythic item in the world. How will this item help him? And can he change his wretched fate?

title: Jisatsutou - Suicide island
summary: When dealing with non-successful suicidal patients, doctors can face a lot of challenges in terms of funding. With a low budget and arguments from a personal respect, the doctor will ask his patient if he/she still wishes to continue living on or not. If the answer is no, then the government will respect their wish. However, the government does not just simply kill them.

title: Kuro no Shoukanshi
summary: A brief description of the manga Kuro no Shoukanshi: He woke up in the world with no memory of himself, not even a name. But this is the world of sword and magic, and he is a conscript. Well, go ahead, get used to the new world!

title: Made In Abyss
summary: An enormous cave system known as the Abyss, is the last unexplored place in the world. No one knows the depths of this titanic pit, inhabited by strange and wondrous creatures, full of mysterious ancient relics whose forgotten purpose has yet to be rediscovered. Generations of bold adventurers came to be known as “Cave Raiders”, all drawn by the cryptic depths of the Abyss. In Oosu, the town at the edge of the Abyss, lives an orphan girl named Rico who dreams of becoming like her mother: A great Cave Raider determined to solve the great mystery of the pit. One day while exploring its murky depths, Rico stumbles upon a little boy, who she discoveres is a robot. Note: Nominated for the 11th Manga Taishou Awards (2018).

title: Medical Return
summary: A brief description of the manhua Medical Return: Kim Jihyun is an ordinary surgeon who couldn’t do any good in his career. However, he had a chance to make things right and start over. So he has school days and the opportunity to become the most popular dermatologist. Do not forget that it’s a lot of money!

title: Mushoku Tensei - Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu
summary: A brief description of the manga Mushoku Tensei – Isekai Ittara Honki Dasu: 34 year old unemployed loser who spent the last ten years of his life without getting out of his room. Dies under the wheels of a truck, trying to save a group of schoolchildren from death. But he does not die, but only moves to the body of a baby in another world. Can this hopeless guy, who has long given up his hand on his life, take advantage of the second chance he has been given? Will he really be able to start all over again and live a new life seriously? To truly become a great person who has gone down in the history of his new world, who will mock the gods and save demons? Or will it remain a useless pervert, dreaming only of how to collect a harem, going crazy for twelve-year-old girls and pulling someone else’s panties? We find out.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
summary: The “Angels” have returned in 2015, and Shinji Ikari, a fourteen-year-old from the new Earth, is made to operate the enormous biomechanical weapon known as “Evangelion” by his father Gendo, the commander of the covert organization NERV, in order to counteract the Angels’ terrifying strength.

title: Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint: The protagonist is the only reader of the daily novel entitled “Three Ways to Survive in a Destroyed World” with more than 3000 chapters. The novel ends with the last chapter, with gratitude and the last words: “The fact that you read it means that you will survive. The next day the protagonist receives a copy of the novel from the author on the phone, after which the content of the novel becomes real. And from that moment on, the game with death starts, where everyone has to do everything to survive.

title: Overgeared (2020)
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Overgeared (2020): Young Woo Shin whole life is not good and carefree. And today, he has to work hard on a construction site to earn a living. And his part-time job is to play Satisfy. But fate itself has prepared a real gift for the guy. The hero of virtual reality, whose name is Grid at the very end of the Northern Cave will find a quest, and then the “Rare Book of Pagma”, having received the legendary class in the game. And this is just the beginning, ahead of so many interesting and unknown things that will help to become a unique class player.

title: Overlord
summary: A brief description of the manga Over lord: The legendary online game “Yggdrasil” suddenly closes. Wishing to stay in the beloved world longer, the player who controls the character named Momonga, decides to stay in the game until the complete shutdown of the servers. Momonga – the head of one of the top guild, representing the game “dark” side. At the moment of server shutdown, he gathered all his servants in the main hall of the guild, sat on the throne and began to wait for the inevitable. But the incredible thing happened: the server did not interrupt the connection, the game continued, and Momonga turned into a skeleton, a powerful wizard. The non-game characters suddenly began to show human emotions. Not having parents, friends and a place in society, Momonga decides not to try to find a way out of the game, and stay in the new world, in order to win it.

title: Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken
summary: A brief description of the manga Tensei Shitara Slime Datta Ken: Satoru Mikami, in his mid-thirties, is an employee and satisfied with his life, but would like to have a girlfriend. He is jealous of his colleague, who has just got engaged to the most beautiful woman in the company. When the two are attacked, Satoru comes to their aid and is stabbed himself. A computer voice speaks to him and when he wakes up again, he can’t move or see anything. After a while Satoru realizes that he has been reborn as a living lump of slime.

title: Release That Witch
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Release That Witch: Cheng Yan went through time and entered a world similar to medieval Europe, becoming Roland, the fourth prince of the kingdom. But this world is not what it is used to. Witches and magic are normal here. Will Roland be able to get the throne of the king and solve the problems that fell to his share? Only his experience of modern technology and the help of witches, known as “Devil’s servants”, will allow him to succeed!

title: Savior of Divine Blood ~Draw Out 0.00000001% To Become the Strongest~
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Savior of Divine Blood ~Draw Out 0.00000001% To Become the Strongest~ A player capable of combating animals from exotic locales. Ariake Subaru, the main character, is picked as a player of the “Rainbow” level, which is neither gold nor silver nor copper, as a result of bullying. His life and position totally altered when he learned how to freely control blood. He eventually gains the reputation as a “Savior” who will save the world as he keeps fighting every day. The burgeoning production team “Studio No.9” presents a contemporary war fantasy!

title: Shangri-La Frontier
summary: Rakurou Hizutome is an avid gamer who loves to both win and trash-talk. He’s mastered every game he’s ever played, including the new VR game Shangri-La Frontier. But can even a skilled gamer like him discover all the secrets that the addictive new game has to offer?

title: SHOKUGEKI NO SOMA
summary: A brief description of the SHOKUGEKI NO SOMA manga: Yukihira Souma’s dream is to become a full-time chef in his father’s restaurant and surpass his father’s culinary skill. But just as Yukihira graduates from middle schools his father, Yukihira Jouichirou, closes down the restaurant to cook in Europe. Although downtrodden, Souma’s fighting spirit is rekindled by a challenge from Jouichirou which is to survive in an elite culinary school where only 10% of the students graduate. Can Souma survive?

title: Skeleton Soldier Couldn’T Protect The Dungeon
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Skeleton Soldier Couldn’T Protect The Dungeon: The only meaning of his life is to protect his beloved hostess. Alas, he could not fulfill his own destiny, but he was given a second chance. Now he can correct his past mistakes and protect the one that won his heart.

title: SOLO LEVELING: HUNTER ORIGIN
summary: Hunter Origin is an original story exclusive to Solo Leveling: ARISE, not found in the original work. It was created under the guidance of the original author to provide a variety of stories and entertainment in the Solo Leveling universe.

title: SOLO LEVELING
summary: A brief description of the manhwa SOLO LEVELING: Ten years ago, the gates of our world opened with a world of monsters. After that, some mortals were given the gift of destroying monsters inside the gate. Such mortals were called hunters. However, not all hunters are strong enough. Sung Jin-Woo is a level E hunter. The guy has to risk his life in the dark dungeons, performing the most unpromising tasks. The fact is that the hunter does not have the necessary qualities to increase, so he has to perform rough work. Sung Jin-Woo went down into the dungeons again and again, fighting with the lowest monsters until one day he wanders into the dungeon level D. Staying in the most difficult dungeon gave the guy an amazing ability “System”, which contains a lot of secrets about raising the level. In order to gain “career growth”, the hunter will have to train regularly, based on the list of tasks. Perhaps such a turn of events will lead the newcomer to the rank of S, the highest title of hunter. By Redice studio that brought you < Solo Leveling: RagnarokSolo Leveling >!

title: Solo Leveling: Ragnarok
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Solo Leveling: Ragnarok: The Earth’s existence is under threat once more as Itarim, the gods of other universes, seek to fill the void left by the Absolute Being. Sung Jinwoo has no choice but to send Beru, the shadow ant king, to awaken his son’s powers and start him on the journey he once took. Suho must conquer the shadow dungeon and earn his place in the world of hunters as he navigates through a new world against a new evil looking to swallow the world whole. [By Redice studio that brought you < Solo Leveling >!]

title: System Universe
summary: A brief description of the webtoon System Universe: Derek lives by one creed. Fight, adapt, and rely only on himself. In the years after the System arrived on Earth and warped it into a monster-ridden wasteland, those rules forged him into one of Earth’s most powerful warriors. They let him thrive in the face of the Apocalypse — until the day he broke them. Failed by his teammates and sent through the void into an entirely new world, fate seems to have wanted Derek to start all the way back from the beginning at level 1. It’s a good thing he brought his old System with him.

title: Tensei Kizoku No Isekai Boukenroku ~Jichou Wo Shiranai Kamigami No Shito~
summary: A brief description of the manga Tensei Kizoku No Isekai Boukenroku ~Jichou Wo Shiranai Kamigami No Shito~ The hero of the manga, Shiina Kazuya, died under strange circumstances to be associated with his girlfriend. She was literally obsessed with magic and fantasy stories. Kazuya turns into young Cain Von Silford. I was baptized on my fifth birthday, according to the traditions of the world in which I live. Something went wrong, I got magical abilities called “Blessing of the Gods.” It turns out that the Gods themselves paid attention to me and awarded me with abilities? … My status has changed after that …. What awaits me ahead?

title: Terror Man
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Terror Man: Sometimes the truth is impossible to see under the cover of lies, and much is not what it seems at first glance. Under the mask of good often hides evil, and under the guise of evil is done good. Jun Woo Ming is considered the most dangerous terrorist in human history. But nobody even suspects that with the help of the gift of foresight, he saves people, sacrificing their own well-being. After all, each saved life turns into a crushing blow of fate for him. He knows first-hand what true happiness and inconsolable grief are.

title: The Beginning After the End
summary: A brief description of the webcomic The Beginning After the End: King Grey has unsurpassed strength, wealth and authority in a world where military abilities rule. However, loneliness remains with those who have great power. Under the glamorous appearance of a powerful king, there is a shell of a man, devoid of purpose and will. Reincarnated in a new world filled with magic and monsters, the king gets a second chance to live his life anew. However, correcting the mistakes of the past will not be his only task. Under the peace and prosperity of the new world, there is a hidden current that threatens to destroy everything for which he worked, questioning his role and the reason for being born again. The Beginning After the End: Side Story – Jasmine: Wind-Borne

title: The Beginning After the End: Side Story - Jasmine: Wind-Borne
summary: A brief description of the webtoon The Beginning After the End: Side Story – Jasmine: Wind-Borne: Full-length side story featuring Jasmine and her past before she joins the Twin Horns. This is never before seen content separate from the novel but entirely canon. The Beginning After the End

title: The Galactic Navy Officer Becomes An Adventurer
summary: A brief description of the “The Galactic Navy Officer Becomes An Adventurer” manga: The spaceship which Imperial Galactic Navy Officer Alan Corinth helmed was shot down by a surprise attack during hyper-space navigation. Completely due to freak coincidence, Alan became the only one in the ship to survive. The severely damaged spaceship lost its navigation capabilities and plummeted onto a nearby planet. Using an escape pod, Alan headed toward the planet alone. Thus began Alan’s quest for survival on the underdeveloped planet utilizing the symbiotic nanomachines [Nanom] within his body. Surprisingly, the planet was home to a thriving human civilization whose genetic code closely resembled Alan’s own. Even while remaining at a loss due to being thrown into a world of swords and magic, he tries to live as best he could together with his newfound comrades. What would Alan achieve this strange world? The Sci-fi Fantasy story in a Medieval setting now begins

title: The King’s Avatar
summary: A brief description of the manhua The King’s Avatar: In the multiplayer online game Glory, Ye Xiu, is well known as the Textbook level expert and a top-tier player. Due to a series of circumstances, he was forcefully expelled out of his professional team. After leaving the pro gaming scene, he resides at an Internet Café employed as one of the managers. When Glory launches the tenth server, he throws himself into the game once more, equipped with ten years of gaming experience, memories of the past and an incomplete self-made weapon. His journey back to the top begins. After plotting and scheming, who took away my glory? Under the influence of the storm, my hopes will never be shattered. In its magnificence, the path will not be lost, for I, will return! The manhua is based on the popular Quan Zhi Gao Shou novel by Butterfly Blue.

title: The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor
summary: A brief description of the The Legendary Moonlight Sculptor manga: The protagonist Han lived through a very difficult childhood in poverty, which made him a very strong, crazy and compulsive person. He tries his best to avoid a repeat of events and to protect his sister and grandmother from the troubles of the outside world, so he plunges into the world-famous game of VRMMO – “The Royal Road”. Throughout the way he will meet very unique people with whom he will have a very unusual relationship. Manhwa is drawn from a legendary book in its genre, the author of which has been recognized by the world (Nam Hi-Sung). It is thanks to his book that the genre of “Literary RPG” became known.

title: The Nebula’s Civilization
summary: A brief description of the manga The Nebula’s Civilization: Choi Seong-woon, achieves the top rank in the game “Lost World,” successfully completing all the game’s achievements. However, his joy doesn’t last long when he receives a suspicious email and is summoned to the real “Lost World,” where he embarks on a competition to become a “god.”

title: The Player that can't Level Up
summary: A brief description of the manhwa The Player that can’t Level Up: Kim GiGyu awakened as a player at the age of 18. He thought his life was on the track to success, climbing ‘the tower’ and closing ‘the gates’… But even after clearing the tutorial, he was level 1. He killed a goblin a day, and he was still level 1. Even after 5 years, he was still level 1. “Who would have thought that this kind of player would exist.” No one knew.

title: The Rising Of The Shield Hero
summary: A brief description of the manga The Rising Of The Shield Hero: Naofumi Iwatan is a typical otaku who is brazenly called to the other world and asked to save him. After a short break, he does decide to agree, becoming one of the four characters in the Shield Hero. And all would be fine if the guy was not robbed on the third day, and also accused of rape… Robbed and humiliated in front of the community, Naofumi decides to find the offenders and give them heat. The raccoon girl he bought out of a slave trader… Adaptation of Aneko Yusagi’s Early Childhood Tate no Yuusha no Nariagari.

title: The World After the Fall
summary: A brief description of the manhwa The World After the Fall: [From the authors of Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint:] Humans were suddenly summoned to become “Walkers”, and they needed to clear the tower to save the world. Then, the “Stone of Regression” was discovered. Walkers could now “return” to the past. And slowly… everyone left. Humanity’s last hope, “Carpe Diem”, was formed by people who refused to abandon the world. But once the last Walker reached floor 100, he no longer knew what to believe. This is the tale of the only man who didn’t regress, despite everyone else going back to the past.

title: The World's Best Engineer
summary: A brief description of the manga The World’s Best Engineer: Kim Soo-Ho, a civil engineer, became a noble from a novel. But what’s this? My estate will be destroyed soon? Then I’ll have to design, build and sell.

title: Tomb Raider King
summary: A brief description of the manhwa Tomb Raider King: Divine tombs in the modern world. People who use the abilities of heroes with the help of relics and people who have received wealth. And also a mysterious tomb raider who came out of nowhere. “Oh, that’s crazy! And here, too, he has cleaned everything up! What was yours was mine. What was mine, of course, was mine! The newborn tomb raider began to hunt all the relics of this world!
